messages:
OpsBot: ALERT: dedicated-resv-pool-42 queue >90% (950+ waiting). Autoscaler failing to fulfill scale-up. Paging infra-oncall and eng-sre.

maria: @sanjay you oncall? seeing a hard stop in pool-42, looks like an enterprise job is saturating reserved GPUs.

sanjay: oncall here. pulling logs now. autoscaler requests are returning PermissionDenied when attempting to create VMs in us-central1. suspect IAM or quota cross-project issue. grabbing full error.

ben: no platform deploys, but I see a long-running training job from HeliosAI started ~02:48 UTC, requested 12 GPUs. They've got heavy checkpointing.

eve: HeliosAI is a reserved tenant on pool-42 for enterprise SLA. If their job is misbehaving it could starve other reserved lanes.

sanjay: autoscaler excerpt: 
```
2026-03-15T02:55:12Z ERROR autoscaler: create-instance failed: googleapi: Error 403: The caller does not have permission., forbidden
```
Looks like service-account used by autoscaler lost compute.instanceAdmin role during a recent perms cleanup.

maria: that would block scaling even if quota exists. OpsBot, page sec-ops and cloud-ops for immediate perms restore.

ops-bot: ACTION: pages sent to cloud-ops, sec-ops, eng-sre, cs-escalations. Incident severity: high, customer impact: HeliosAI latency and queueing.

cs-bot: @cs-lead please notify HeliosAI that we're investigating and may interrupt their training job; flag that we'll try to avoid data loss (checkpointing).

cs-lead: reaching out to Helios contact (Priya). Message: "We're seeing infrastructure issues affecting your training; we may need to pause or migrate to reduce customer impact. Will confirm ASAP."

ben: quick mitigation options: 1) temporarily throttle background/low-priority requests 2) signal Helios trainer to checkpoint and pause 3) attempt manual VM creation using cloud-admin account as a workaround 4) evict low-priority pods from pool-42.

sanjay: I can attempt manual VM create from cloud-admin while cloud-ops fixes SA perms. doing that now to buy time.

eve: also worth enabling per-tenant concurrency caps on pool-42 routes to stop any single tenant from saturating.

maria: agree. apply conservative caps for non-SLA tenants and set HeliosAI to 'protected' but ask them to reduce concurrency if possible.

sanjay: manual VM create successful using admin creds -> added 4 GPUs to burst-subpool. queue dropped ~25% within 90s. autoscaler still failing until perms restored.

ops-bot: NOTE: temporary burst-subpool created in us-central1 (admin-account). 4 GPUs online.

ben: executed low-priority eviction on pod selectors: batch-worker=best-effort with graceful 90s termination. freed another 6 GPUs.

cs-lead: Helios replied: "We can pause training for 30m and resume once stable. Please checkpoint first." They allowed pause.

sanjay: signaled trainer with SIGUSR1 to trigger checkpoint (we use in-house trainer hooks). Checkpoint confirmed. Pausing job now. freed 12 GPUs. pool-42 util down to ~60%.

eve: perms fix from cloud-ops arrived: service-account restored compute.instanceAdmin + iam roles. Autoscaler attempts resumed. Observed one successful scale event.

sanjay: autoscaler recovered, started scaling nodes back into pool-42; queue normalized.

maria: great. summary so far: root cause chain = accidental perms removal during tidy-up -> autoscaler unable to scale -> single large HeliosAI job plus noisy neighbors caused reserved pool starvation -> manual admin steps and tenant pause mitigated.

ben: follow-ups we should record: add an autoscaler fallback to attempt admin-account create when SA returns 403; add guardrail to prevent single-job from consuming >X% of reserved pool; incident runbook for SA role-deletes.

eve: also action: create detection rule for repeated 'create-instance forbidden' errors and auto-page cloud-ops.

sanjay: filing INC-2026-0315-03. Owners: infra (sanjay) for SA perms & autoscaler fallback, sres (ben) for eviction tooling, product (eve) for quota/concurrency rules, cs (maria) for customer comms.

maria: handing off to @alex for next shift. Notes: HeliosAI paused, burst-subpool in place, autoscaler healthy. Watch pool-42 for 2h; escalate if queue >75% or error 403 recurs.

alex: taking handoff. added 2h watch and alerts. I'll coordinate with cloud-ops for permanent perms/quotas and ensure Helios job restarts cleanly.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated. Last actions: tenant paused and admin-burst pool added; autoscaler perms restored. Documenting timeline to INC ticket.

cs-lead: composing customer-facing note for HeliosAI: apology + summary + mitigation + commitment to runbook changes.

maria: post-incident items: 1) runbook "autoscaler-perms-fail" 2) implement autoscaler-admin-fallback 3) tenant concurrency caps 4) add SA-permission-monitoring 5) schedule postmortem next week.

sanjay: snippet for ticket log: 
```
03:12 UTC Helios job start -> 03:20 autoscaler 403 errors -> 03:25 manual admin vm create -> 03:30 low-prio evictions -> 03:36 Helios checkpoint+pause -> 03:45 perms restored -> 03:50 autoscaler resumed -> 03:55 queues normalized
```

alex: acknowledged. I'll track customer follow-up and confirm restart procedure succeeds. Closing thread and moving notes into postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
